title: Salacious B. Crumb
franchise: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
description: A Kowakian monkey-lizard, Salacious B. Crumb sat on the dais next to Jabba the Hutt at the crime lord's palace and on his Sail Barge. During the fighting that broke out during Luke Skywalker's escape at the Sarlacc Pit, Crumb attacked C-3P0. R2-D2 shocked Crumb to protect his friend. Crumb likely perished when the Sail Barge exploded.
